svg.title: LANE DETECTION: Drivable lanes and junctions on roads with no lane markings.
svg.desc: COMPUTER VISION · AUTONOMY. ~50 fps 640×360 on an RTX 3050 laptop; 4 of 7 frames to confirm a junction; 0 training runs, pretrained only. Stack: PyTorch, OpenCV, YOLOPv2, RANSAC
